proposal.summary: NO — the Runtime cannot complete the roadmap autonomously from the current state. It is single-mission by construction: odg.js -> odg-run.js consumes ONE mission name from argv, runs the fixed pipeline (mission-interpreter -> mission-loader -> execution-planner -> capability-registry -> knowledge-engine -> [project-context] -> Fleet Bridge -> decision-engine -> patch-engine -> patch-executor -> validation-engine -> mission-ledger) exactly once, prints PIPELINE SUCCESS, and exits. Nothing re-enters the loop. The Fleet exchange (fleet-stage: dispatch -> bridge.drainOnce -> collect) only produces and validates a {mission,summary,actions} proposal for the SAME mission; fleet-collector records it in the mission-ledger and stops — no component consumes the proposal or its VALIDATED state to select and launch a successor. The roadmap (RUNTIME_ROADMAP.md) and MISSION_QUEUE.md are static human-readable markdown marked [QUEUED]; no code parses them into an ordered mission list, advances a cursor, or checks a completion condition. mission-ledger is append-only evidence, not a scheduler. Governance principle #2 ('never modify the repo automatically') and the propose-not-apply patch gate are deliberate autonomy boundaries requiring CTO validation. Result: each mission is a terminal, operator-triggered run; missions are NOT automatically chained.
actions: CONFIRM: no automatic mission chaining exists — odg-run.js:8 takes a single argv mission and odg-run.js:40-54 loops over PIPELINE STAGES, not over MISSIONS

IDENTIFY MISSING MECHANISM: a roadmap-driven orchestrator/scheduler loop that (1) parses MISSION_QUEUE.md / RUNTIME_ROADMAP.md into an ordered, stateful mission list, (2) invokes odg-run for the current mission, (3) on VALIDATED marks it DONE and advances the cursor to the next QUEUED mission, (4) repeats until the queue is exhausted, with an explicit termination/completion and failure-halt condition
NOTE: the Fleet proposal.actions are generated and validated but never fed back to spawn the next mission request — the feedback edge from collector/ledger to dispatcher is absent
NOTE: MISSION_QUEUE.md [QUEUED] markers are never mutated to [DONE]; there is no persisted progress cursor across runs

BOUNDARY (by design, not a defect): patch-executor proposes and does not auto-apply, and governance-kernel requires CTO validation — full unattended roadmap completion would additionally require an approved auto-apply policy
VERDICT: current state = manually-chained single-mission runtime; autonomous roadmap completion requires adding the mission-chaining loop above. No files were modified.
